lines.en: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our town.
lines.zh: 乔·桑德斯拥有我们镇上最漂亮的花园。

lines.en: Nearly everybody enters for 'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year, but Joe wins every time.
lines.zh: 几乎每个人都报名参加一年一度的“最漂亮的花园比赛”，但乔每次都获胜。

lines.en: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
lines.zh: 比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的大。

lines.en: Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables, but Joe's garden is more interesting.
lines.zh: 比尔比乔干活更卖力，种的花和蔬菜也更多，但乔的花园更有趣。

lines.en: He has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
lines.zh: 他修筑了整洁的小径，还在池塘上架起了一座木桥。

lines.en: I like gardens too, but I do not like hard work.
lines.zh: 我也喜欢花园，但我不喜欢辛苦的劳动。

lines.en: Every year I enter for the garden competition too, and I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
lines.zh: 每年我也报名参加花园比赛，却总是因为镇上最差的花园而赢得一个小奖！

lead.question: 乔·桑德斯的花园为何年年夺冠，而作者的花园却年年垫底？
lead.warmup: 乔·桑德斯有全镇最漂亮的花园：他修了整齐的小径，还在池塘上架起一座木桥，因此每年“最漂亮的花园比赛”几乎都由他夺冠。比尔的花园更大、干活更卖力、花也种得更多，却仍败下阵来。作者同样年年参赛，却因不爱劳动而年年捧回小奖。学习时留意 best、worst 等不规则形式。
goals: 掌握形容词、副词比较级与最高级的构成及 than 的用法
辨别 best / worst / more 等不规则形式，分清 -er 与 more 的分工
学会用 not as … as 把比较级改写为同级否定句
活用 enter for、win a prize、grow flowers、hard work 等本课搭配
lead.summary: 本课以一场花园比赛串起形容词与副词的比较：larger、harder、more flowers 用比较级加 than，most beautiful、worst、best 则是最高级。乔赢在花园更有趣，比尔的花园虽大却略逊一筹。此外牢记 enter for 表“报名参加”，win a prize 表“获奖”，work 作“劳动”讲时不可数。
lead.tips: than 后比较对象要同类，如 Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's（Joe's 即 Joe's garden），不能写成 than Joe；enter the room 是“进入”，enter for the competition 才是“报名参赛”。

questions.q: Whose garden is the most beautiful in the town, and who has the worst one?
questions.zh: 谁的花园是全镇最漂亮的，谁的又是最差的？
questions.a: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in the town, and the writer has the worst one.
questions.aZh: 乔·桑德斯有全镇最漂亮的花园，而作者的花园最差。
questions.hint: 抓首句 Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden 与末句 the worst garden in the town。

questions.q: Why does Joe win although Bill Frith's garden is larger than his?
questions.zh: 既然比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的大，乔为什么还能获胜？
questions.a: Because Joe's garden is more interesting: he has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
questions.aZh: 因为乔的花园更有趣：他修了整洁的小径，还在池塘上架了一座木桥。
questions.hint: 注意 but Joe's garden is more interesting 中的转折。

questions.q: What does Bill Frith do better than Joe?
questions.zh: 比尔·弗里斯在哪方面做得比乔更好？
questions.a: Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables.
questions.aZh: 比尔干活比乔更卖力，种的花和蔬菜也更多。
questions.hint: 比较级 harder 与 more 并列出现。

questions.q: What prize does the writer win every year and why?
questions.zh: 作者每年赢得什么奖？为什么？
questions.a: He always wins a little prize for the worst garden in the town, because he likes gardens but does not like hard work.
questions.aZh: 他每年赢得“全镇最差花园”的小奖，因为他喜欢花园却不喜欢辛苦劳动。
questions.hint: 定位 I do not like hard work 与 win a little prize。

questions.q: If you entered for 'The Nicest Garden Competition', what would you do to win?
questions.zh: 如果你报名参加“最漂亮的花园比赛”，你会怎样取胜？
questions.a: I would work hard, make neat paths and grow more flowers, because interesting ideas and hard work together make a garden the nicest.
questions.aZh: 我会辛勤劳动，修整洁的小径、种更多的花，因为巧思与勤劳结合才能让花园成为最美的。
questions.hint: 结合 neat paths、hard work 与比较级来谈自己的做法。

exercises.q: 汉译英：几乎每个人都报名参加一年一度的“最漂亮的花园比赛”，但乔每次都获胜。
exercises.a: Nearly everybody enters for 'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year, but Joe wins every time.
exercises.note: enter for 表“报名参加”；习惯性动作用一般现在时。

exercises.q: 汉译英：每年我也报名参加花园比赛，却总是因为镇上最差的花园而赢得一个小奖。
exercises.a: Every year I enter for the garden competition too, and I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town.
exercises.note: worst 前加 the；win a prize 为固定搭配。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 not as … as 改写 Joe's garden is more interesting than Bill's.
exercises.a: Bill's garden is not as interesting as Joe's.
exercises.note: 比较双方需互换位置，as … as 中用原级。

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 last year 改写 Joe wins every time.
exercises.note: win 的过去式为 won，属不规则变化。

exercises.q: 填空：Bill works ____ (hard) than Joe and grows ____ (many) flowers and vegetables.
exercises.note: 两者均为比较级，后接 than。

exercises.q: 填空：He has made ____ (整洁的) paths and has built a ____ (木质的) bridge ____ a pool.
exercises.note: neat paths、wooden bridge、over a pool 为课文搭配。

exercises.q: 改错：I like gardens too, but I do not like hard works.
exercises.a: I like gardens too, but I do not like hard work.
exercises.note: work 表“劳动”时不可数，不加 -s。

quiz.q: 乔为什么每次都能在花园比赛中夺冠？
options: Because his garden is the largest in the town.
Because his garden is more interesting, with neat paths and a wooden bridge.
Because he grows the most vegetables in the town.
Because nobody else enters for the competition.
quiz.note: 课文说 Joe's garden is more interesting，largest 说的是比尔。

quiz.q: 比尔的花园与乔的相比如何？
options: It is smaller than Joe's.
It is larger than Joe's.
It is as large as Joe's.
It is the largest garden in the town.
quiz.note: 原文 Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's。

quiz.q: 下列哪一句表达了“乔的花园比比尔的有趣”？
options: Joe's garden is interesting than Bill's.
Joe's garden is more interesting than Bill's.
Joe's garden is the most interesting than Bill's.
Joe's garden is as interesting than Bill's.
quiz.note: 两者比较用比较级 more interesting + than。

quiz.q: 作者每年得到的是什么奖？
options: A little prize for the worst garden in the town.
The first prize for the best garden in the town.
A large prize for growing the most vegetables.
No prize at all for his garden.
quiz.note: 他因“镇上最差的花园”获得一个小奖，是课文的幽默结尾。

quiz.q: 哪一句中 enter for 的用法正确？
options: He entered the dark room quietly.
Nearly everybody enters for the competition each year.
She entered the garden by the back gate.
They entered into the house one by one.
quiz.note: enter for 表“报名参加”；enter 单独用表“进入”。

quiz.q: 选出填入两处空白的正确形式：Bill works ____ than Joe and grows ____ flowers.
options: harder; more
more hard; more
harder; most
more hard; most
quiz.note: 两者相比用 harder 与 more，不可用双重比较或最高级。
